root_checks.general_checks_scope: Separate repository checks; focused test and independent review results are bound above. Acquisition/publication commands were dry runs.

accepted_scope: Exact supplied base ADT extraction with bounded pinned parser and explicit source profile. Ten test groups, 23 compiled assertion mutants and eight independent cases pass.
Pmap attributes, all physical and remap rows, duplicates and zero-valued remaps are preserved with raw property provenance. IOVA remains opaque.
Full named VRAM allocation descriptor is retained. Source count limit 256 refuses overflow without truncation; no interval union or policy conversion occurs.
limits: Historical extraction is a replay of saved bytes, not fresh acquisition or an old boot regrade.
Source labels, root cell checks and hashes do not establish authentication, global exclusion coverage, physical ownership or a safe hardware mapping.
hardware_decision: STOP003 remains. Last recorded state is verified Linux. No SSH, boot, reset, deployment or native API execution in this admission. Shared APCIE PHY/PMGR writes remain compiled out; GPU held; serial bridge stopped; no Signal.
next_step: Isolated source integration and bounded private observer design only. A separately reviewed concrete packet is required before any hardware decision.
